description: This file defines an internal object AiPlayer responsible for selecting moves in a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe game. It includes methods for choosing moves based on difficulty levels, implementing minimax algorithm for optimal play, and managing game logic such as determining winners and available moves.
published: chooseMove(board: Array<Char?>, aiSymbol: Char, difficulty: Difficulty): Int?

classes.name: AiPlayer
classes.description: Singleton object providing AI move logic for Tic Tac Toe, including different difficulty levels and minimax algorithm.

classes.name: AiPlayer.Difficulty
classes.description: Enum class representing difficulty levels for AI: EASY, MEDIUM, HARD.

methods.name: chooseMove
methods.description: Selects the best move index based on the AI symbol and current board state using minimax for optimal play.

methods.name: chooseMove
methods.description: Selects a move index based on specified difficulty: random, semi-random, or minimax.

methods.name: chooseRandomMove
methods.description: Selects a random move from available moves.

methods.name: minimax
methods.description: Implements the minimax algorithm to evaluate board states and determine optimal move scores.

methods.name: availableMoves
methods.description: Returns a list of indices of empty cells on the board.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks the board for a winner according to predefined winning lines.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game state is a draw.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Returns the opposing symbol ('X' if input is 'O', and vice versa).
